notes: DRAFT, not run yet. Save ladder route (ladders\Hogwarts.json): the harness installs the rung's save as HL-01-09.sav (aram han's manual slot 10, unused by the user). The title-screen character card loads that character's newest save by the SaveTime in SaveGameList.sav, and autosaves (slots 10-14, written a minute or so into every run) always get today's date, so the card only keeps loading the ladder slot if SaveGameList.sav lists HL-0c-09 as used with a date in the future: one-time prep, see the ladder's "prep" (install runs\save-sets\hogwarts\own\ladder\prep\SaveGameList.sav plus one HL-0c-09.sav per character, game closed). Each ladder file's own DirectoryEntry is patched the same way (slot HL-0c-09, USER, 2099-01-01), so the list and the file agree. A copy into a slot the list marks unused is ignored (demo2's HL-01/02/03 files are not shown). Route: title (any key) > the character card (card_cp / card_xy: A H 78, ARAM HAN 165, HARRY PORTER 252, GEN Z 338) > loading (the hint band, loading) until gone 5 s > settle_s > play (WASD, Shift sprint, Space jump, mouse camera, LMB basic cast, R Revelio, 1-4 spells; never F interact, M map, Tab tool wheel, K photo mode, Esc except to quit) > Esc (field guide) > 설정 > 게임 종료 > Space. Never 게임 저장 (manual save: would overwrite a slot), 이전 저장에서 다시 시작, 인게임 스토어, 모드 플레이. Variants Hogwarts-save-c0 / -c2 / -c3 are this route for the other characters (only save_slot and the card vars differ). Unknowns for discovery: the prologue (Gen Z) may open another pause menu on Esc; a save that starts in a cutscene shows no gameplay until it ends; there is no HUD checkpoint that fits every character (the spell bar differs), so the field guide after play is the gameplay proof and the shots spawn / before-quit show which story point loaded. After a ladder, the ARAM HAN card keeps loading HL-01-09 (dated 2099), also for the plain Hogwarts recipe: end the ladder with open-world-l34 (the same point as the user's newest autosave) or unregister the slots (hl_save.py unregister in the scratchpad tools).
